chunks.title: Enterprise GenAI Model Deployment & Shadow Release SOP
chunks.text: Under Enterprise Release Gate GATE-AI-104, every generative AI and retrieval-augmented service must pass an offline deterministic benchmark before promotion to staging or production. The release artifact must record SHA-256 digests for both the evaluation dataset and model weights, achieve a minimum NDCG@10 score of 0.82, maintain a Passage Claim Support Rate of at least 0.85, and demonstrate a pre-retrieval RBAC Leakage Rate of exactly 0.0 across all role tiers.

chunks.title: Enterprise GenAI Model Deployment & Shadow Release SOP
chunks.section_heading: 2. Shadow Deployment Telemetry & PSI Drift Ceiling
chunks.text: New retrieval or reranking models must execute in shadow deployment mode (canary silent parallel evaluation alongside the active production baseline) for a minimum of 72 hours. Automated telemetry monitors query-embedding Population Stability Index (PSI) and latency. If the Population Stability Index (PSI) distribution shift exceeds the drift ceiling of 0.08 or CPU P99 latency exceeds 450 milliseconds, the circuit breaker triggers an immediate rollback to the deterministic baseline.

chunks.title: Enterprise GenAI Model Deployment & Shadow Release SOP
chunks.section_heading: 3. Audit Log Retention & Hallucination Incident Escalation
chunks.text: Immutable retrieval traces containing query hashes, role clearances, and cited chunk SHA-256 digests must be retained for 90 calendar days in append-only audit storage. If post-synthesis NLI monitoring detects an unsupported claim rate above 3.0% over any rolling 24-hour window, an incident ticket under code INC-SEV2-RAG must be escalated to the AI Safety Lead within 4 hours.

chunks.title: Enterprise Token Quota, Caching & FinOps Cost Attribution Standard
chunks.section_heading: 1. Daily Tenant Token Quotas & Semantic Cache TTL (FIN-QUOTA-312)
chunks.text: Standard FIN-QUOTA-312 enforces deterministic token governance across all internal workspaces. Each business unit tenant is capped at 2,500,000 input tokens per day and 400,000 output tokens per day. Identical queries against an unchanged corpus SHA-256 digest are served from a deterministic response cache with a 24-hour TTL.

chunks.title: Enterprise Token Quota, Caching & FinOps Cost Attribution Standard
chunks.section_heading: 2. Budget Variance Throttling & Local CPU Fallback (CHARGEBACK-CC-77)
chunks.text: Under Cost Control CHARGEBACK-CC-77, cost centers that exceed their monthly LLM API budget allocation by more than 15% are automatically throttled to quantized local CPU models until a variance sign-off is approved by the VP of Finance.

chunks.title: GDPR Article 28 Data Processing, PII Redaction & Cross-Border Transfer Standard
chunks.text: Under Clause GDPR-ART28-ANNEX-B, any external cloud or AI subprocessor handling enterprise data must execute a countersigned Data Processing Addendum (DPA) prior to integration. All vector indices, relational databases, and telemetry logs must reside exclusively within EU/EEA sovereign data centers in eu-central-1 (Frankfurt), with a binding 72-hour personal data breach notification SLA.

chunks.title: GDPR Article 28 Data Processing, PII Redaction & Cross-Border Transfer Standard
chunks.text: Before any document is chunked or embedded into the retrieval store, deterministic PII detectors must screen for German tax identifiers (Steuer-ID, 11 digits), statutory health insurance numbers (KVNR, 10-character alphanumeric), and international bank account numbers (IBAN, MOD-97-10 checksum). Confirmed personal identifiers must be replaced with salted SHA-256 pseudonyms prior to indexing.

chunks.title: GDPR Article 28 Data Processing, PII Redaction & Cross-Border Transfer Standard
chunks.section_heading: 3. Article 17 Right to Erasure Purge SLA (ERASURE-SLA-14D)
chunks.text: Workflow ERASURE-SLA-14D governs GDPR Article 17 erasure requests. When a data subject or enterprise client revokes consent, all associated document chunks, SQLite FTS5 inverted index tokens, dense vector embeddings, and cached HITL review records must be cryptographically purged and verified absent within 14 calendar days.

chunks.title: Cryptographic Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) Review & Digest Binding Standard
chunks.text: Control HITL-DIGEST-801 specifies when a RAG response cannot be released directly to end users and must enter the transactional SQLite review queue with status pending_review. Automatic queueing occurs whenever: (a) any retrieved passage is flagged as stale beyond max_staleness_days, (b) the passage claim support rate falls below 0.72, or (c) the query touches regulated compliance boundaries.

chunks.title: Cryptographic Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) Review & Digest Binding Standard
chunks.section_heading: 2. SHA-256 Evidence Digest Binding & Upstream Invalidation
chunks.text: Human reviewer sign-off (approve or reject) is cryptographically bound to the composite evidence digest: SHA256(normalized_query || sorted_chunk_sha256_digests || answer_sha256). Before serving any previously approved response, the runtime recomputes the digest against current corpus chunk hashes. Any upstream document edit changes the chunk SHA-256 and automatically transitions the record status to invalidated_by_upstream_edit.

chunks.title: Confidential Executive Compensation, M&A Retention & Workforce Severance Policy
chunks.section_heading: 1. Band L7 Principal AI Engineer Equity & M&A Acceleration (HR-COMP-901)
chunks.text: CONFIDENTIAL SCHEDULE HR-COMP-901: Principal and Staff AI Engineers classified in Band L7 are eligible for an annual Restricted Stock Unit (RSU) refresh ceiling of EUR 85,000, vesting quarterly over 4 years. In the event of a change-in-control M&A transaction, Band L7 agreements include a 12-month double-trigger vesting acceleration clause and a retention bonus equal to 35% of base salary.

chunks.title: Confidential Executive Compensation, M&A Retention & Workforce Severance Policy
chunks.text: CONFIDENTIAL SCHEDULE HR-SEV-902: In an organizational restructuring or reduction in force, eligible employees receive a severance payout of 1.5 months of base salary per completed year of continuous service, up to a maximum cap of 18 months, plus a fixed EUR 6,000 career outplacement transition stipend.

chunks.title: Board Litigation Reserve, Regulatory Investigation & Settlement Authority Protocol
chunks.text: PRIVILEGED PROTOCOL LEG-RES-604: The General Counsel holds autonomous authority to settle regulatory investigations or commercial IP disputes up to EUR 350,000 per matter. Any proposed settlement or consent decree exceeding EUR 350,000 requires formal resolution from the Board Audit & Risk Committee.

chunks.title: Board Litigation Reserve, Regulatory Investigation & Settlement Authority Protocol
chunks.section_heading: 2. EU AI Act Supervisory Penalty Reserve (RESERVE-EUAI-2026)
chunks.text: PRIVILEGED SCHEDULE RESERVE-EUAI-2026: The corporation maintains a ring-fenced regulatory contingency reserve of EUR 4.2 million under general ledger account GL-9940-LIT to cover potential supervisory conformity audits or administrative proceedings under high-risk AI system annexes.

chunks.title: Regulated Medical Device & Clinical AI Software Governance (ISO 13485 / EU MDR)
chunks.text: Directive MED-MDR-704 governs AI-assisted workflows in healthcare and medical imaging environments under EU MDR and ISO 13485. Generative and retrieval systems are strictly classified as clinical documentation and evidence-lookup aids; they must never issue autonomous diagnostic conclusions or treatment orders. Licensed clinician sign-off is mandatory for all Class IIa and Class IIb workflows.

chunks.title: Regulated Medical Device & Clinical AI Software Governance (ISO 13485 / EU MDR)
chunks.text: In accordance with traceability control ISO-13485-CL-7.5.8, every synthesized clinical protocol answer must display the exact source document ID, page number, effective date, and SHA-256 content digest. If an underlying clinical SOP is updated, all previously approved summaries referencing the superseded digest are automatically invalidated.

chunks.title: Regulated Medical Device & Clinical AI Software Governance (ISO 13485 / EU MDR)
chunks.text: Post-Market Surveillance (PMS) audits must be executed every 90 days on clinical retrieval pipelines. Synthesized responses must achieve a minimum NLI passage entailment score of 0.78 on every atomic sentence, and any response citing a guideline within 15 days of staleness expiration must display an explicit clinical governance warning.

chunks.title: Enterprise Cloud & AI Vendor Procurement Policy
chunks.text: Schedule TIER-PROC-302 defines commercial approval authority by Annual Contract Value (ACV). Contracts up to EUR 50,000 require Procurement Lead approval. Contracts between EUR 50,001 and EUR 250,000 require joint sign-off from the VP of Procurement and the Data Protection Officer (DPO). Any AI or cloud agreement exceeding EUR 250,000 ACV requires formal authorization from the Executive Tender Board.

chunks.title: Enterprise Cloud & AI Vendor Procurement Policy
chunks.text: Every commercial agreement with a foundation model or external inference provider must incorporate Clause CL-ZDR-09 (Mandatory Zero-Data-Retention). Under CL-ZDR-09, the vendor warrants that enterprise prompts, retrieved passages, and outputs are never used for model training or weight updates, and volatile inference buffers are wiped within 24 hours.

chunks.title: Enterprise Cloud & AI Vendor Procurement Policy
chunks.section_heading: 3. Supplier Security Attestation & CycloneDX SBOM Requirement
chunks.text: Prior to purchase order issuance, software vendors must submit a current SOC 2 Type II report or ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certificate alongside a machine-readable CycloneDX 1.6 Software Bill of Materials (SBOM). Artifacts with unresolved critical CVEs (CVSS >= 9.0) are blocked from procurement onboarding.

chunks.title: Hybrid Retrieval & Cross-Encoder Reranking Architecture Standard
chunks.text: Architecture Specification SPEC-RET-208 mandates a dual-index retrieval layer over page-aware document chunks. The lexical index uses SQLite FTS5 with BM25 scoring (parameters k1=1.2 and b=0.75) to capture exact alphanumeric identifiers, regulatory codes, and statutory clauses. The dense semantic index projects chunks into 384-dimensional L2-normalized embeddings (all-MiniLM-L6-v2 / ONNX CPU execution) scored via exact cosine similarity.

chunks.title: Hybrid Retrieval & Cross-Encoder Reranking Architecture Standard
chunks.section_heading: 2. Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF k=60) & Cross-Encoder Reranking
chunks.text: To reconcile uncalibrated BM25 unbounded scores with bounded cosine similarities [-1, 1], rankings are combined via Reciprocal Rank Fusion using smoothing constant k=60: RRF_score(d) = 1/(60 + rank_lexical(d)) + 1/(60 + rank_dense(d)). The top 12 fused candidates are then rescored by a local Cross-Encoder reranker (cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2) that computes joint query-passage interaction logits before selecting the final top-k context window.

chunks.title: Hybrid Retrieval & Cross-Encoder Reranking Architecture Standard
chunks.text: Security Control AC-PRE-01 strictly prohibits post-retrieval permission filtering. Role-based access control predicates must filter the candidate chunk pool before executing SQLite FTS5 match queries or dense matrix products. Post-retrieval filtering is banned because restricted chunks can displace authorized evidence from the top-k window and create side-channel inference risks.

chunks.title: Third-Party Binary & Open-Source Software Intake Gatekeeper SOP
chunks.text: Standard SEC-GATE-511 requires automated read-only intake inspection of third-party packages and compiled binaries before enterprise use. The scanner extracts embedded dependency metadata across Go buildinfo, Rust cargo-auditable sections, Electron ASAR bundles, NuGet deps.json, Python dist-info, and nested Maven pom.properties up to 2 archive levels deep.

chunks.title: Third-Party Binary & Open-Source Software Intake Gatekeeper SOP
chunks.section_heading: 2. Electron Fuse Hardening & Code-Signing Diff Gate (RULE-ELEC-04)
chunks.text: Under Enforcement Rule RULE-ELEC-04, desktop Electron applications must disable RunAsNode and EnableNodeCliInspectArguments fuses and keep webSecurity set to true. Any binary update that weakens Electron fuses, enables insecure browser flags, strips Windows Authenticode signatures, or alters the Authenticode publisher subject triggers an automatic REJECT or mandatory security review.

chunks.title: Third-Party Binary & Open-Source Software Intake Gatekeeper SOP
chunks.text: Temporary risk acceptance for non-critical intake findings is governed by control WAIVER-MAX-30D. Every policy waiver must be recorded in TOML configuration with a named security approver, issue tracker reference, and an expiration timestamp no more than 30 calendar days from issuance. Expired waivers fail closed in CI.
